status: ABORTED after 3 of 135 runs; not evidence for any metric.
reason: Harness defect: the seed service closed its listening servers with Server.wait_closed() before closing the open peer connections; on Python 3.12 that waits for every connection, so the seed hung on SIGTERM, docker stop killed it and no seed statistics were written. ttfb_after_first_handshake_s and unused_downloaded_bytes were therefore missing (unused bytes even negative). The smoke run did not show it. Fixed in the harness (close order; statistics written before closing; unused bytes only with complete statistics) and re-registered as pb0-v2.
